card.name: Italian history and names
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected Italian name or place in history text about Italy (Caporetto, Italian prime ministers, Tuscan or Venetian figures). It also fires weakly on the start of the abbreviation CH in chronic hepatitis.

modes.label: Italian history text
modes.description: Small words like by, of or V right before an Italian person's name or an Italian topic.
modes.example: as perceived<< by>> the Italian Prime Minister, Vittorio

modes.label: CH abbreviations
modes.description: The letters CH starting a hepatitis abbreviation in label text.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage for Adults with<< CH>>B The recommended PEGASYS dosage

card.writes: It suppresses San/Santo-type name pieces, so it seems to steer the model away from continuing with a San- name.
card.plain: It lights up in Italian history passages just before a name, such as an Italian leader, is expected.
